# Memory and compute estimate (slice s9)

<!-- Generated by `python -m research.estimate.estimate`. Do not edit by hand; tests regenerate and diff it. -->

> **Every number in this document is an estimate, not a measurement.** Research prototype, not for clinical use. No GPU job was run to produce it. The Tier-2 smoke manifests listed at the end name the measurements that will replace these figures.

## Formulas

Implemented once in `research/estimate/estimate.py`; integer bytes. `B` = bytes.

| Term | Formula | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| Frozen weights | `M_weights = 2 B x P_total` | bf16. ZeRO-3 shards it: `/ N`. ZeRO-2 and 1 GPU do not. |
| LoRA parameters | `P_lora = sum_(adapted matrices) r x (d_in + d_out)` | Hu et al. <https://arxiv.org/abs/2106.09685>. |
| Trainable state | `M_trainable = 16 B x (P_lora + P_connector)` | bf16 param 2 + fp32 master 4 + Adam m 4 + v 4 + grad 2. ZeRO-2: `2 P_t + 14 P_t / N`; ZeRO-3: `16 P_t / N` (Rajbhandari et al. <https://arxiv.org/abs/1910.02054>). |
| Activations | `L x s x b x h x 2 B + max_layer_type [s x b x h x (34 + 5 a s_span / h)]` | Gradient checkpointing: stored layer inputs plus one recomputed layer (Korthikanti et al. 2022 <https://arxiv.org/abs/2205.05198>). `s_span = s` (full attention), `min(s, window)` (sliding), `0` (linear attention: the attention-only term does not apply in hybrid models). Upper bound when fused/flash attention is used. |
| Logits | `b x s x V x 4 B` | fp32 logits; large vocabularies make this a real term. Chunked loss would remove most of it. |
| 3D path | `b N d_enc 34 + 5 heads b max(F S^2, S F^2)` + connector `b N d 2 (1 + n_layers) + n_layers b (n_q d 34 + 5 heads_c n_q N)` | Frozen CT-CLIP encoder under no_grad (factorised spatial/temporal attention; `S` tokens per frame, `F` frames, `N = S F`) plus the trainable fixed-token connector at the declared volume shape and `n_q` tokens. |
| Connector parameters | `P_connector = d_in d + d + n_q d + n_layers (12 d^2 + 15 d) + 2 d + d d_out + d_out` | Matches `FixedTokenConnector`. |
| Tokens per step | `micro_batch x seq_len x grad_accum x data_parallel` | |
| Compute | `FLOPs ~= c x P_active x T_tokens` | `P_active = P_total` (conservative: includes the idle 2D vision tower). |
| Time | `time = FLOPs / (N_gpu x peak x MFU)` | GPU-hours = `FLOPs / (peak x MFU) / 3600`. |

**The value of `c`.** Full fine-tuning costs about 6 FLOPs per parameter per token (forward 2, backward 4: activation gradients 2 plus weight gradients 2). With a frozen backbone and LoRA, weight gradients exist only for the small adapters and the connector, but activation gradients must still flow back through every frozen layer to reach the adapters (stage 3) and the image tokens at the input (stage 2). That gives `c ~= 4`. Gradient checkpointing reruns the forward pass (+2), so `c ~= 6`. This estimate uses the range `c = 4 to 6`.

## 27B flagship

Required by CLAUDE.md before any flagship run. **Every figure below is an estimate, not a measurement.** No figure is carried over from the withdrawn 4B target; all are computed here from the approximately 27B candidates' own cited parameter counts. Lingshu-32B is shown at its true size (about 33.45B).

### Compute

GPU-hours for stage 2 (connector) + stage 3 (LoRA), times the runs multiplier. Low = low tokens, `c = 4`, high MFU, low multiplier; high = the opposite.

| Candidate | Stage-2 tokens (low to high) | Stage-3 tokens (low to high) | GPU-hours, one pass (low to high) | GPU-hours incl. runs multiplier (low to high) |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| medgemma-27b-it | 13,154,304 to 154,177,536 | 300,000,000 to 1,500,000,000 | 9.4 to 134.5 | 18.9 to 672.3 |
| qwen3.8-27b | 13,154,304 to 154,177,536 | 300,000,000 to 1,500,000,000 | 9.5 to 136.2 | 19.1 to 680.8 |
| lingshu-32b | 13,154,304 to 154,177,536 | 300,000,000 to 1,500,000,000 | 11.5 to 164.0 | 23.0 to 819.8 |

### Storage

Itemized, decimal GB. Adapter and checkpoint sizes use r = 8 (low) and r = 64 (high). Resume checkpoints hold the trainable state only (16 B per trainable parameter), times the retention count. Dataset sizes are ASSUMPTION ranges.

| Candidate | Base weights | Adapter (bf16) | Resume checkpoints x retention | Datasets (CT-RATE, MIMIC-CXR, MIMIC-IV) | Cached 3D encoder features | Total (low to high) |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| medgemma-27b-it | 54.9 | 0.2 to 1.0 | 4.2 to 38.8 | 5,510.0 to 25,100.0 | 363.7 to 710.5 | 5,933.0 to 25,905.1 |
| qwen3.8-27b | 55.6 | 0.1 to 0.7 | 3.4 to 28.0 | 5,510.0 to 25,100.0 | 363.7 to 710.5 | 5,932.8 to 25,894.7 |
| lingshu-32b | 66.9 | 0.2 to 1.1 | 4.7 to 45.4 | 5,510.0 to 25,100.0 | 363.7 to 710.5 | 5,945.5 to 25,923.9 |

Preliminary experiments hold all three base checkpoints at once: 177.3 GB.

### Cost

GPU-hours x price per GPU-hour. **The price is an ASSUMPTION** (USD 3.0 to 8.0); with a granted allocation it is the opportunity cost.

| Candidate | Cost, USD (low to high) |
|---|---|
| medgemma-27b-it | 57 to 5,378 |
| qwen3.8-27b | 57 to 5,447 |
| lingshu-32b | 69 to 6,558 |

### Schedule

Wall-clock on one 8x B200 node, assuming the whole node is available. Proposal 1.5: base-model study and preliminary fine-tune (tasks 6-7) in semester 1, before the progress report on 4 Dec 2026; the approximately 27B fine-tune (task 9) in semester 2, January to May 2027 (about 20 weeks).

| Candidate | Wall-clock days on 8x B200 (low to high) | Share of the semester-2 window (low to high) |
|---|---|---|
| medgemma-27b-it | 0.1 to 3.5 | 0.1% to 2.5% |
| qwen3.8-27b | 0.1 to 3.5 | 0.1% to 2.5% |
| lingshu-32b | 0.1 to 4.3 | 0.1% to 3.0% |

Compute time is not the binding constraint on these assumptions; data access (CT-RATE, PhysioNet), the Tier-3/4 approval, and evaluation are. Any Tier-3/4 run needs explicit human approval recorded in docs/DECISIONS.md.

### Fallback

If stable approximately 27B training is not possible on the granted compute, the fallback is the strongest valid smaller model, reported at its true scale and never relabelled (proposal 1.3.4: reduce the base-model size or the training scope).

## Measurements that replace these estimates

The Tier-2 smoke manifests (`research/manifests/`, status `planned`) each measure peak GPU memory, tokens/s, loss decrease and a checkpoint round-trip on one B200 for at most 60 minutes:

- `smoke-s2-connector-medgemma-27b-it`
- `smoke-s3-lora-medgemma-27b-it`
- `smoke-s2-connector-qwen3.8-27b`
- `smoke-s3-lora-qwen3.8-27b`
- `smoke-s2-connector-lingshu-32b`
- `smoke-s3-lora-lingshu-32b`
